scope: Strict OpenAPI and runtime response contracts for the private location-scoped extension-learning module catalog and aggregate summary.

constraints.items: at most 50; only ID, module name, schema-constrained category/difficulty/content type, optional duration, and language
constraints.request_path: response location must match requested path

constraints.groups: bounded by exact category/status/channel/type enum products: 55, 48, 5, and 18 maximum entries
constraints.request_path: response location must match requested path
constraints.privacy: aggregate fields only; no learner identity, score, free text, contact, error, or metadata fields

error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized route-specific 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie

limitations: This closes the code-level API response contract only; live OIDC, populated-data parity, and broader tenant isolation remain separate gates.
